### 2026-10-08 – I made the schematics to connect the 16x2 LCD screen to the Arduino Uno as well as add the buttons to control the score. It was hard to find the right parts at the start, but I found them after a litt

**3h**

I made the schematics to connect the 16x2 LCD screen to the Arduino Uno as well as add the buttons to control the score. It was hard to find the right parts at the start, but I found them after a little looking. Then I spent some time wiring the PCB. Running the traces took forever because DRC was being a pain.

### 2026-10-09 – This was mainly coding, but it won't let me attach my Wakatime project. I don't know why, but it won't, so here we are. Coded inputs for score changing. I also set up the score updating based on when

**2h**

This was mainly coding, but it won't let me attach my Wakatime project. I don't know why, but it won't, so here we are. Coded inputs for score changing. I also set up the score updating based on when the button goes from HIGH to LOW (it's pulled up). I'm using when the button changes states so that the loop function does not add a million scores to one team since it runs thousands of times a second.
